spans.s:
दुग्ध p. p. [दुह्-क्त]
1 Milked, milked
out.
--2 Extracted, drawn out &c.
--3
Collected, filled, full.
--ग्धं
1 Milk.
--2
The milky juice of plants.
--3 Milking.
--Comp.
--अग्रं, --अम्रं, --तालीयं the
skim of milk, cream.
--दा a milch cow.
--पाचनं a vessel for boiling milk.
--पोष्य a. living on the mother's
milk (as a child), a suckling.
--फेनः
cream.
--बंधः, --बंधकः the post to
which a cow is tied before being
milked.
--बीजा rice mixed with
milk.
--समुद्रः, --अब्धिः the ocean of
milk, one of the seven oceans.
